items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: You mentioned the other night about Jack Carey, that's why I thought you met him. Yeah, yeah. Well that was uh, his trumpet player at that time.

ctx.x: But it had been Mutt Carey by any chance.

Mutt, that's who it was. Now that, Mutt Carey has got a brother by the name of Chris Kelly, not Chris Kelly. Jack Carey. Jack Carey, that's right. Jack Carey. You see I just can't think of those things like I was like. You mentioned the other night about Jack Carey, that's why I thought you met him. Yeah, yeah. Well that was uh, his trumpet player at that time.

Oh yeah, Mutt played there with Jewel Barnes and something. And uh, Zeb. Zeb used to play Kliney. Oh, do you ever remember any other part of his name? No, all I know was Zeb. All you knew was Zeb. Yeah.
